## `neuro.number.parseInt`

Static method on `Number`.

> Converts A string to an integer.

## Signatures

```ts
parseInt(input: { string: string; radix?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Number.parseInt` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
